steps.instruction: Cook 1/2 cup of onion and 1/2 cup of celery in 2 tablespoons of butter.
steps.spoken: In a large pan, cook 1/2 cup of chopped onion and 1/2 cup of chopped celery in 2 tablespoons of butter or margarine, until soft.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 cups of cooked, chopped chicken and 1 3/4 cups of hot water.
Stir in 2/3 cup of long grain white rice and 1 can of mushrooms with liquid.
steps.spoken: Stir in 2/3 cup of long grain white rice and the 10 ounce can of mushrooms, with their liquid.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 cup of frozen peas and carrots and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme and rosemary.
Put it all in a covered 8-cup baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the rice is tender.
steps.spoken: Bake covered for about 30 minutes, until the rice is tender.
